placements.title: the pipeline owns identifier creation when none is supplied
placements.frame: When a memory arrives without an explicit id, how does the pipeline fulfill its responsibility to produce a slug and commit the file?

This passes the grain test: it names a subject true beyond the words it describes, not a one-time fact.
